title: Party — customer or supplier
description: The party master: one document family covering both sides of a trade, distinguished by party_type rather than by two near-identical schemas. The closed party_type enum is the harvested shape (upstream carries Customer and Supplier as separate doctypes with the same field surface), and keeping one family is what lets a purchase order link a party and a sales order link the same document without the model claiming they are different kinds of thing.

party_type.description: Which side of a trade this party is on. Closing the enum is what makes 'is this a supplier?' a question the model answers rather than guesses at.

name.description: The party's display name (its legal or trading name).

tax_id.description: The jurisdiction's tax registration identifier. Deliberately free-text and bounded: its shape is jurisdiction-specific, so pinning a pattern here would refuse valid parties.

credit_limit.description: The exposure ceiling a credit check compares against. Absent means no ceiling is declared.

disabled.description: A disabled party stays linked by history but may not be selected on a new document.

harvest: the party field surface (name, tax_id, territory, credit limit, disabled)
the two doctypes' shared shape, collapsed into one family with a closed party_type discriminant
currency is a party attribute, which is what makes a document's currency defaultable from its party
x-erp-provenance.note: Field shapes from the upstream party doctypes, re-expressed as one family. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
